system.description: Spending a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait causes the world to seem to slow to a crawl; maintaining the effect costs one Blood Trait per turn. You gain an automatically successful free attack against anyone without Advanced Celerity, and an extra action taken before opponents with Advanced Celerity or after those with Celerity powers of your own tier. Attacks from anyone with less than Advanced Celerity automatically fail against you unless you stand still, and only those with Advanced Celerity or higher may attempt to stop you or your Fair Escape.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait to activate, one per turn to maintain
system.duration: Sustained, one turn per Blood Trait spent
